name: VELO Pulse Runner
material: Engineered mesh upper, EVA foam midsole, rubber outsole
description: A dependable daily trainer with a soft EVA midsole that stays comfortable from the first kilometre to the last. The engineered mesh upper keeps air moving on hot mornings, and the clean all-white finish works just as well off the road.

name: VELO Pulse Runner
material: Engineered mesh upper, EVA foam midsole, rubber outsole
description: Our everyday running shoe in a tonal black that hides dust and puddle splashes. Balanced cushioning, a secure heel counter and a durable rubber outsole make it an easy choice for easy runs and long walks alike.

material: Monofilament knit upper, nitrogen-infused foam, carbon-fibre plate
description: Built for tempo sessions and race day. A featherweight knit upper sits over nitrogen-infused foam and a full-length carbon plate for a snappy, propulsive ride that rewards faster paces.

name: VELO Aero One
material: Monofilament knit upper, nitrogen-infused foam, carbon-fibre plate

material: Jacquard mesh upper, dual-density max-cushion foam, rubber outsole
description: Maximum cushioning for long runs and recovery days. A tall, dual-density foam stack softens every landing while a wide base keeps things stable when your legs start to tire.

name: VELO Street Core
material: Full-grain leather upper, cushioned insole, stitched rubber cupsole
description: Our signature everyday sneaker in all-black leather. Sharp enough for the office, relaxed enough for the weekend, and easy to keep looking new.

material: Premium suede and nylon upper, foam midsole, gum rubber outsole

material: Premium suede and nylon upper, foam midsole, gum rubber outsole

name: VELO Core Trainer
